title: Perpetual Help pulls away from EAC for breakthrough win in Season 102
summary: Perpetual Help on Thursday barged into the win column of the NCAA Season 102 men's basketball tournament after an 83-72 triumph over Emilio Aguinaldo College at the Filoil EcoOil Centre in San Juan.
